value.rationale: The first nontrivial fully square rectangular perfect-matching complex has known mixed-dimensional homotopy, but its D4 representation is not implied by that homotopy classification. The complete character in each homological dimension determines which cycles survive every geometric symmetry: none. This gives an exact, natural benchmark for equivariant perfect-matching topology and rational topology of quotient spaces, not a cosmetic parameter slice.
